scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build: cd backend && npm install && npm run db:generate && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.start: cd backend && npm run build && NODE_ENV=production node dist/index.js
scripts.start:win: cd backend && npm run build && set NODE_ENV=production && node dist/index.js
